data.description:
Step into the enchanting world of HuntyVerse, a delightful virtual reality hunting experience. With its playful charm and captivating gameplay, HuntyVerse offers a lighthearted alternative to traditional hunting games—don't worry no animals were harmed!

Choose between two unique worlds: Hunty Duckz, a free-to-play adventure, and Deer Park, available for just $2.99. Both feature vibrant, animated landscapes filled with adorable targets and exciting challenges. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a competitive player, HuntyVerse guarantees endless entertainment with its accessible and addictive gameplay.

Test your skills across three engaging modes designed to challenge your reflexes, precision, and strategy. Compete with friends or climb global leaderboards to prove yourself against players worldwide. Each round brings fresh opportunities for fun and friendly competition in a fully immersive VR setting.

What sets HuntyVerse apart is its commitment to accessibility and comfort. Play from your chosen space—no need for bulky gear, outdoor setups, or weather concerns. Designed for newcomers and seasoned VR players alike, it’s an experience everyone can enjoy.

Whether you’re perfecting your aim in Hunty Duckz or exploring the whimsical wilderness of Deer Park, HuntyVerse combines charming visuals, intuitive controls, and action-packed content for a memorable arcade-style shooter. Ready to dive in? Start your adventure today!

changelog.change_log: Left Handed Gameplay! Click shoot on either controller to switch between hands.

Hunty Duckz is now FREE.
New Level, Deer Park, available as add-on.

- Device Leaderboard:
  - Track your own top 10 scores
  - Edit name option for device leaderboard scores
